# 🚀 Release Checklist

## Scope and documentation
- [ ] Release contents reviewed.
- [ ] README and relevant docs updated.
- [ ] Changelog updated.
- [ ] License and asset attribution checked.
- [ ] Known limitations listed.

## Quality
- [ ] Structural validation executed.
- [ ] Changed HTML opened in browser.
- [ ] Console checked.
- [ ] Local images verified.
- [ ] Internal documentation links checked.
- [ ] No secrets or temporary files included.

## Publication
- [ ] Version/tag chosen if applicable.
- [ ] Release notes match actual changes.
- [ ] CI results inspected.
- [ ] Deployment URL verified if a deployment exists.
